Positive sampled Jacobian and normal wall thickness do not certify global flexible-skin self-contact or material strain.
Native shank/clamp contacts and tender weld/dragbox contacts are intentional contact interfaces; clamp preload, weld strength and service fatigue are unverified.
Whole coach stays rigid; wheelset steering/rolling, train traction dynamics, locomotive/tender articulation, pitch/roll/slack and operating safety remain unsolved.
